notes: Unlocking the bootloader erases ALL user data (anti-theft) — complete a fresh backup first. Verified on UP1A.231105.001.B2 (2026-11-07): 'fastboot flashing unlock' returns host-side OKAY immediately while the on-device volume-key prompt gates the actual wipe. Google's published anti-rollback warnings cover Pixel 6/8 (May 2025) and Pixel 10 (May 2026) — Pixel 5 is not listed, but flash only factory images matching or newer than the installed build.
